analyses.estimateComment: Confidence interval and p-value are one-sided for test of null hypothesis that the LS mean difference between NBI-1065846 and placebo in DARS total score at Day 57 is greater than or equal to zero.

primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: The DARS is a dynamic scale that measured desire, motivation, effort and consummatory pleasure across hedonic domains. The DARS is a self-report questionnaire that measured anhedonia across 4 domains: hobbies/past-times, food/drinks, social activities, and sensory experiences. The DARs was rated on a five-point Likert scale from 0 (not at all) to 4 (very much), higher values indicating less anhedonia. All items were summed up to a total score in the range of 0 to 68.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: Full Analysis Set (FAS): All randomized participants. Here, 'Overall number of participants analyzed' = participants evaluable for specified outcome measure.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Change in Anhedonia Severity, as Measured by Change in DARS Score From Baseline to Day 57
